description: The tiebreaker-resolved FALLBACK locale, the third branch of DefaultStrings.java:446-469, which no other fixture in the corpus reaches. Construction therefore walks the tiebreaker list and adopts its first entry that is canonically equivalent to the configured tag: hy-AM here.
